entities.name: Elementary 5GSM procedure
entities.description: A basic procedure in 5G Session Management that performs a specific function and consists of one or more messages exchanged between the UE and the network.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that initiates or responds to 5GSM procedures.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The 5G core network elements that participate in 5GSM procedures.

entities.name: 5GSM message
entities.description: A message exchanged between the UE and network as part of an elementary 5GSM procedure.

relations.description: An elementary 5GSM procedure consists of one or more 5GSM messages exchanged between UE and network.
The UE can initiate elementary 5GSM procedures.
The network can initiate elementary 5GSM procedures.
Elementary 5GSM procedures are defined by the exchange of 5GSM messages.
